_comment: Which data assets exist. bundle-assets, setup-data, upload-osf and upload-zenodo all read this file, so a new asset is one entry here and no code change. dir: folder under the project root. archive: tarball name on OSF/Zenodo. optional: a missing or failed asset is a warning, not an error. default: part of the selection when nothing narrows it. Narrow per run with --only/--exclude, or for good with ASSETS / ASSETS_EXCLUDE (env or scripts/.env); more entries can come from the file named in ASSETS_FILE.

dssat.description: DSSAT planting date x cultivar output (PDC, Nigeria maize)
